description: This Java interface defines the BookRepository, a Spring Data JPA repository for managing Book entities. It includes custom query methods with entity graph fetch strategies to optimize loading related entities such as author, tags, publishers, and predefined shelves. The repository provides methods for retrieving books with various filters, including by ID, title, author, shelf, and user-specific collections.

classes.name: BookRepository
classes.description: A Spring Data JPA repository interface for Book entities, providing custom query methods with optimized fetch strategies.

methods.name: findAllBooks
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of all books with related entities loaded via entity graph.

methods.name: findAll
methods.description: Retrieves all books with related entities loaded via entity graph.

methods.name: findBookById
methods.description: Finds a book by its ID, including related entities.

methods.name: findByTitleContainingIgnoreCase
methods.description: Finds books with titles containing the specified string, case-insensitive.

methods.name: findByTitleOrAuthor
methods.description: Finds books where the title or author's full name matches the search term, case-insensitive.

methods.name: findAllBooksByPredefinedShelfShelfName
methods.description: Finds books associated with a specific predefined shelf name.

methods.name: findAllBooksForUser
methods.description: Finds all books associated with a specific user, including user-created shelves.
